allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Officer Chan Ka Kui manages to put a major Hong Kong drug dealer behind the bars practically alone, after a shooting and an impressive chase inside a slum. Now, he must protect the boss' secretary, Selina, who will testify against the gangster in court.

facts.overview: Officer Chan Ka Kui manages to put a major Hong Kong drug dealer behind the bars practically alone, after a shooting and an impressive chase inside a slum. Now, he must protect the boss' secretary, Selina, who will testify against the gangster in court.
facts.title: Police Story

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Chan managed to bring down the crime boss virtually alone, but keeping his star witness safe long enough to reach the courtroom proves even more volatile.
visibleEditorialCopy.description: After single-handedly arresting a major drug lord following a chaotic chase through a hillside slum, Hong Kong police officer Chan Ka Kui is assigned to guard the kingpin's key witness, his secretary Selina.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced and exciting with moderate crime stakes, balancing high-impact action and lighthearted comic energy.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by Jackie Chan, this energetic blend of crime thriller, physical comedy, and kinetic stunt work delivers relentless momentum and suspenseful witness-protection stakes.

issueSummaries: description says Chan 'single-handedly' arrested the drug lord. The overview hedges this as 'practically alone', so the copy turns a qualified claim into an absolute one. The curiosityHook keeps the hedge with 'virtually alone', so the two fields also disagree.
description adds 'hillside' to the slum. The overview says only 'inside a slum', so this is an unsupported location concretization.
description says Chan 'is assigned to guard' the witness. The overview says 'he must protect', with no institutional assignment stated. This is a mild causal and mechanistic concretization.
claudeAdvisory.sourceBoundaryReason: Most of the copy is grounded or is tolerated figurative language and genre shorthand under A_PRIME_PRODUCTION_MATERIALITY_V1. The description has three small unsupported concretizations: the removed hedge ('single-handedly' for 'practically alone'), the added location detail ('hillside slum'), and the institutional framing ('is assigned to guard'). Each falls under a named materiality category (quantities/factual attributes, locations, causality/mechanics), and the copy contradicts itself on the hedge across fields. None distorts the premise, invents identities or outcomes, or changes what a viewer would expect, so the severity is MINOR and not SEVERE. No spoiler-boundary content appears, since the copy stays at the setup. A bounded fix would use 'practically alone' or 'virtually alone', drop 'hillside', and use 'must protect'.

sourceEvidence.notes: description: 'single-handedly' has no support as an absolute. The source says 'practically alone', which allows for some help. 'Hillside' is absent from the overview, which says only that the chase took place inside a slum.

description: Officer Chan Ka Kui, the major Hong Kong drug dealer put behind bars, the chase in a slum, the boss's secretary Selina, and her testimony all restate the overview. 'Chaotic' for 'impressive' is a figurative variant. 'Kingpin' and 'drug lord' paraphrase 'boss' and 'major drug dealer'. 'Key witness' follows from 'will testify against the gangster in court'.

curiosityHook: 'crime boss', 'virtually alone', 'star witness' and 'reach the courtroom' restate the overview. 'Proves even more volatile' asserts that the protection duty is more dangerous than the arrest. The overview does not say this, but it reads as metaphorical urgency and names no specific event or outcome.

'Crime thriller', 'physical comedy' and 'kinetic stunt work' are consistent with genres Action/Comedy/Crime. 'Jackie Chan' matches director, and 'Hong Kong' matches countries. 'Thriller' is not a listed genre, but it is tolerable genre shorthand alongside the suspenseful mood. 'Stunt work' is generic action shorthand.

acceptedSemanticClassification: 'Fast-paced' and 'relentless momentum' match pace=fast. 'Exciting' and 'suspenseful' match moods. 'Lighthearted comic energy' matches mood funny. 'Moderate crime stakes' is a loose echo of emotionalWeight=moderate and is not a factual claim.

claudeAdvisory.uncertaintyNotes: This is a near-threshold call. Each item alone could reasonably be approved as minor contextual concretization, in the class of the tolerated 'across the countryside'. 'Hillside' is the closest to that class, and 'assigned to guard' is a natural gloss on 'must protect' for a police officer. I flag the description because the three additions accumulate and the hedge is dropped in one field but kept in another. The curiosityHook's 'proves even more volatile' is a comparative that the packet does not support, but I left it within tolerance as metaphorical urgency. If Sophia weighs the items individually, APPROVE is defensible.
